svg.title: Customer voice: colour first
svg.desc: Fictional retail dashboard with 240 products in eight categories, 12 weekly review counts, sentiment distributions, deviation from a benchmark, a review-volume heatmap and category share donut. Uses colour as the primary cue to category identity. Exact values are in dashboard-data.json and the HTML data tables.

g.text: Fictional retail data · 240 products · 8 categories · 12 weeks · 8,040 new reviews
Categorical · each mark is one product
Categorical · eight series, the same category identities
Semantic · positive, neutral and negative sentiment
Diverging · net sentiment minus a +45-point benchmark
Sequential · darker means more reviews, not a new category
Categorical · eight slices: already a useful stress test
High point counts do not require one colour per point. Here, 240 products share eight categorical colours.
